_comment: Stage 3 skeleton for Joker (2019) recap - REBUILT v2 (2026-06-18) to match frame-verified shots.json v2. Medium Register B. Units source-time chronological from U02 onward; only U01 (hook) has narrative_jump=true. must_cover references catalogued beats 1-37 (v2 numbering). SC REORDER (v2): Penny smother (beat 25, 01:21) precedes the Joker transformation+stairway dance (beat 26, 01:24-01:31) in source - so U13 = Penny smother, U14 = Becoming Joker (was reversed in v1). NEW U15 = detective subway chase (beat 27, 01:33), standalone STANDARD lean unit; old U15-U19 + U_outro renumbered to U16-U20 + U_outro. UNRELIABLE NARRATOR (alpha): U01-U09 narrate Sophie (beats 9/15) as REAL; U10 contains the explicit beat-21 Sophie-imagined reveal; U11-U20 acknowledge Arthur's unreliable perception; U19 preserves the Arkham ambiguity. S9 SILENCE units: U08 (beat 13 bathroom dance ~22s), U14 tail (beat 26 stairway dance ~22s), U18 (beat 35 Joker on car ~13s) bind silence shots that carry NO narration line (C1 exception). G4 restraint at climaxes. C3: U19 and U_outro bind different beat-36/37 shots.

units.label: Hook - the man who became the Joker
units.why: Viral cold-open: Arthur's descent (alley beating beat 3 + bus laughing-fit beat 5 + subway-shooting beat 12 over branding) without spoiling the Sophie/reality twist. Question hook + Serabudabu branding + title. All hook lines narrative_jump=true.

units.label: Gotham, and a clown named Arthur
units.why: World intro (decaying Gotham) + Arthur intro (forced smile, beaten). 2-3 interpretive lines on his invisibility/recognition need.

units.label: A medicated life
units.why: Social worker + Penny intro. Penny interpretive: she shaped his 'put on a happy face' mask.

units.label: The dream of being seen
units.why: Murray idol + the daydream of being called on stage. Theme seed: Arthur's hunger for recognition/validation. Daydream (beat 7) tagged real (unreliable).

units.label: A gun and a girl
units.why: Randall's gun + Sophie intro. Sophie narrated as REAL (pre-twist).

units.label: Everything falls apart
units.why: Hospital gun-drop -> fired -> bus laughing fit (beat 5, source-earlier but covered here for arc) -> the subway harassment that lights the fuse.

units.label: The subway
units.why: S6 subway shooting - the first kills, the turning point. Beat 11 (laughter erupts, men close in) leads into beat 12 (the kills). G4 restraint; S7/S8 censor at render.

units.label: Something awakens
units.why: S9 SILENCE: bathroom dance (beat 13, ~22s, no narration line - C1 exception). Lead-in framing lives in U07 tail.

units.label: A city in clown masks
units.why: City reacts to the killings; Sophie date (REAL pre-twist); failed open-mic; Murray mocks him on TV. Sophie still narrated as real.

units.label: Who is Arthur Fleck
units.why: Penny's Wayne claim -> manor gate -> Wayne denies + adoption -> [REVEAL] Sophie was imagined. EXPLICIT pivot. Heaviest unit.

units.label: The truth in the file
units.why: Arkham records: adopted + abused. The last thread of his identity unravels. Post-reveal: narration acknowledges Arthur's perception is unreliable.

units.label: No more tragedy
units.why: S6 Randall murder; Gary spared. The first killing he chooses cold. G4 restraint; S7/S8 censor at render.

units.label: He erases his past
units.why: S6 Penny smother (beat 25, S8 strong region). He smothers his hospitalized mother - the last tie to who he was. SOURCE-ORDER: this precedes the transformation (v2 reorder, was U14). G4 restraint.

units.label: Becoming Joker
units.why: The transformation (makeup) + beat-26 S9 SILENCE stairway dance (~22s, no narration line). Brief framing line before the silence. SOURCE-ORDER: follows Penny smother (v2 reorder, was U13).

units.label: The net closes
units.why: NEW standalone unit (v2): two detectives corner the Joker in a subway packed with clown-masked rioters; he slips away in the chaos. Lean transitional beat (40-60w), G4 restrained, action carries the weight.

units.label: Live with Murray Franklin
units.why: Backstage -> entrance -> confession to the subway killings -> the rant. The idol becomes the stage for his reckoning. Theme: society that made him. (was U15)

units.label: What you deserve
units.why: S6 Murray shooting on live TV. G4 - quiet, let it land. S7/S8 censor at render. (was U16)

units.label: Gotham burns
units.why: Riot atmosphere + the Wayne murders (Batman origin) - the chaos he sparked births a new myth. Retention/theme on society. (was U17)

units.label: The myth is born
units.why: Beat-35 S9 SILENCE: Joker rises on the police car (~13s, no narration line). One framing line; let the crowd's roar carry it. G4. (was U18)

units.label: You wouldn't get it
units.why: Arkham ending. Preserve the film's intentional ambiguity (how much was real) - do NOT over-explain. Reality-vs-perception theme closes here. (was U19)

units.label: Closing thoughts
units.why: Thematic closure (society creates its monsters; recognition denied) + thanks + subscribe. Bound to the closing corridor shot (beat 37), different from U20's beat-36 shot (C3).
